settings.title: Attribute Panel Settings
settings.help: Document rules match attribute names and control display name, visibility, editability, and order. These are global defaults; per-document exceptions live in the panel Field settings dialog.
settings.optionsHint: Only for select / multi-select; press Enter to add
settings.readOnlyCapability: This field is managed by SiYuan. Its value cannot be changed here; the display name is only a plugin alias.
settings.resetConfirm: Reset to defaults? Unsaved changes will be lost.

fieldSettings.title: Current field settings
fieldSettings.subtitle: Applies to this document only. Unoverridden fields still use global defaults.
fieldSettings.emptyHint: No fields yet. Add an exact-match rule in Attribute Panel Settings, or add an attribute in the panel.
fieldSettings.typeOverrideHelp: Edit method and options apply to this document only; restore default to use global rules
fieldSettings.renderMethodHelp: Render method comes from global Attribute Panel Settings and cannot be changed here
